  "sourceScopeBoundary": "HK300 derives common actual compact-tilt cumulant bounds and an all-x C/n Hermite first-correction remainder for EVERY real H representing literal actual Sn, hence closes the previously explicit-bound-only compact-model consumer gap. HM302 proves true weighted-reference L1 and relative integration for nonnegative Lebesgue-L1 f, bounded measurable nonnegative phi and measurable signed reference, requiring relative error only on f!=0. HN303 applies this to the SAME actual E, actual tilted IID nu, actual cell exponential indicator and the SAME H provided by accepted HF: E/C precede epsilon; N precedes all n,p,qualifying cells. For literal nonnegative Gaussian weighted J0 it proves |integral f dnu-J0|<(C/n)*J0+epsilon/n^3 with true integrability. HO304 uses actual original P=mu^n and sample mean/energy M and exact P.real(M^-1cell)=exp(-n rateAtMean)*integral f dnu; the normalized physical probability satisfies the SAME relative-plus-epsilon/n^3 bound. rateAtMean=p dot actualmean-log(actual MGF) is NOT silently identified with a freely chosen Legendre minimum/selected anchor. Consumer assumptions: compact Theta in true joint MGF interior, positive actual tilted covariance determinant, uniform weak Cramer with 0<=beta<2/5,c>0,R>=0; qualifying half-open rectangles contain mean in their closed versions and each width<=1/n, intersect the retained parabolic strip. The original law may be atomic; no original density, polynomial-witness coherence, tail continuity or reflection package is assumed.
